_readme: MT-010 Phase 2 output. Checks which of the 20 SSG->PowerShell programs have a Trial3/manifest/programs.manifest.json 'proof' entry (a refimpl-derived expected.dat under Trial3/fixtures/<dir>/), and whether OUR Tier-1 sgs-values.json seed actually matches that entry's paramOverrides/conditionValues (per each program's own sgs-values.json '_source' field, which already documents this). IMPORTANT CAVEAT (repo memory, confirmed 260917): Trial3's fixtures/expected.dat files are produced by a DIFFERENT execution engine - a 'refimpl' PowerShell reference implementation that simulates REAL file I/O (reads mock input.dat, computes actual output bytes) for the COBOL->C# pipeline. Our own Tier-1 harness (SsgPsMockLib.psm1) does NOT simulate file I/O at all - it only captures literal lines passed to DataLineOrNoStatement (SSG parameter-substituted COBOL/print text), with Call-ExternalProgram/file operations recorded but not executed. So even for the 'confirmed same parameters' programs below, a byte-diff between our Tier-1 .out.txt and Trial3's expected.dat is NOT meaningful pass/fail proof - they're answering different questions. What IS useful: these fixtures give AMT172 an independently-derived expected VALUE/BEHAVIOUR reference (record counts, byte layout, branch semantics) to check their REAL Connect-Application run against, once they do real file I/O.

ARCHIFORMAT.notes: Trials/ARCHIFORMAT/sgs-values.json's own _source field states it was seeded directly from this manifest key (brackets stripped). Computed A=69/B=68/C=67/D=66/E=65 in the AMT172 trial run matches hand-calculation - consistent with this fixture's record-size assumptions.

ARCHISEPARE.notes: Trials/ARCHISEPARE/sgs-values.json's own _source field confirms direct seed from this manifest key.

BABA_ASCII.notes: No Trial3 manifest key for BABA_ASCII. Seed came from the .ps1's own GetSgsValue keys, loop counts at 0 (see MT-010 Phase 1 loop-count-zero gap).

CFH-COPY.notes: Trials/CFH-COPY/sgs-values.json's own _source field confirms direct seed from this manifest key. This is the program the AMT172 Stage A / live-CC trial already reported PASS on (structurally identical COBOL codegen to the trial-11-cfh-copy candidate, only diff = our own SSG-STUB comment annotations).

CFH-COPY_ASCII.notes: GAP: Trials/CFH-COPY_ASCII/sgs-values.json was reused/adapted from CFH-COPY's seed (same values), but CFH-COPY_ASCII.TXT is a DIFFERENT source file with different FILE-CONTROL (DISC/DISP-1 assign vs CFH-COPY's UNISERVO/MASS-STORAGE, per DiscDesignators.json). Same parameter VALUES, different source-variant semantics - do not hand this fixture to AMT172 as CFH-COPY_ASCII's confirmed golden; it's a close reference only.

CHAB100_ASCII.notes: No Trial3 manifest key. Seed reused from CHABAN_ASCII's own (independently derived, not manifest-sourced) seed.

CHABAN_ASCII.notes: No Trial3 manifest key. Seeded from the .ps1's own GetSgsValue keys, loop counts at 0.

CONDIS2_ASCII.notes: No Trial3 manifest key. PG=0 seed skips the whole record-layout generation loop.

EXTEUR.notes: No Trial3 manifest key. COND=0 seed skips the whole record-layout/procedure generation loop.

FUSBA_ASCII.notes: No Trial3 manifest key. Adapted from FUSBA2_ASCII's own (also non-manifest) seed.

FUSBA2_ASCII.notes: No Trial3 manifest key. Minimal seed, loop counts at 0.

LECTIS_ASCII.notes: Trials/LECTIS_ASCII/sgs-values.json's own _source field confirms direct seed from manifest key LECTIS. NOTE: manifest programId is 'LECTIS' (no _ASCII) though our source/script filename is LECTIS_ASCII - see the Area C naming rule (output name = input filename, not PROGRAM-ID). This program also has the KEYS-named condition flag that triggers the T3-007 ETS-shadowing hazard if a harness doesn't use .PSBase.*.

LOADIS_ASCII.manifestKey: LOADIS_MULT-NODUP (cross-checked overlap only, not a full seed)
LOADIS_ASCII.notes: Trials/LOADIS_ASCII/sgs-values.json's own _source field says 'derived from source directives; cross-checked against manifest key LOADIS_MULT-NODUP where the same tokens overlap' - NOT a full 1:1 paramOverrides seed like CFH-COPY/ARCHIFORMAT/ARCHISEPARE/LECTIS. Treat this fixture as a partial cross-check, not a confirmed golden.

LOADIS_MULTI.notes: No manifest key named LOADIS_MULT or LOADIS_MULTI (only LOADIS_MULT-NODUP exists, which is what LOADIS_ASCII cross-checks against, not this program). Seed is a mirror of UNLOADIS_MULTI's table with input/output roles swapped.

RECAP.notes: No Trial3 manifest key. Minimal seed derived from source, ASCII path selected.

SCAN_ASCII.manifestKey: SCAN (fixture exists but parameters DIFFER from our seed)
SCAN_ASCII.notes: GAP - IMPORTANT: Trials/SCAN_ASCII/sgs-values.json's own _source field explicitly says 'No Trial3 manifest entry for SCAN_ASCII' and uses DIFFERENT values than the manifest's SCAN key (e.g. our INPUT,1,1,2=100 vs manifest's 80; our INPUT,1,1,3=10 vs manifest's 1). Do NOT hand fixtures/scan/expected.dat to AMT172 as SCAN_ASCII's golden - it was computed for a different parameterization.

TABAN_ASCII.notes: No Trial3 manifest key. SCHEMA=0 seed deliberately skips a schema-selection loop whose *EXIT would map to a script-terminating PowerShell Exit.

TAPELD_ASCII.notes: Trials/TAPELD_ASCII/sgs-values.json's own _source field confirms reuse from manifest key TAPELD_DISTRIB (same programId 'CFH-COPY' template, per the manifest's own programId field).

UNLOADIS_ASCII.notes: Trials/UNLOADIS_ASCII/sgs-values.json's own _source field explicitly says 'not in Trial3 manifest', seeded from the .ps1's own GetSgsValue keys. Manifest has two same-programId (UNLOAD-ASCII) candidates (UNLOADIS_MULT / UNLOADIS_MULT-NODUP) but neither was used as our seed - left unresolved rather than guessed.

UNLOADIS_MULTI.manifestKey: UNLOADIS_MULT (cross-checked overlap only, not a full seed)
UNLOADIS_MULTI.notes: Trials/UNLOADIS_MULTI/sgs-values.json's own _source field says 'cross-checked against manifest key UNLOADIS_MULT (same element name, same token scheme)' - not a full 1:1 seed. Treat as partial cross-check.

caveat: Do not represent any 'confirmed-seeded-from-manifest' entry above as a byte-diff PASS against our Tier-1 harness output - see _readme. It means our SGS parameter seed intentionally matches the manifest's paramOverrides/conditionValues, so the two pipelines were asked the same question; it does not mean the two outputs were ever diffed against each other (different execution engines: refimpl file-I/O simulation vs Tier-1 line-capture mock).
